entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CSharpIntroduceParameterCodeRefactoringProvider encountered an error and has been disabled #82049
  • C# editor. Automatically added code is not removed by undo ( Ctrl-Z ) operations. #82048
  • [Bug — BannedApiAnalyzers] Namespace (N:XXX) level triggers are not working as expected or intended #82047
  • Csc task performs unnecessary probes for `dotnet.exe` #82044
  • "Generate new type" creates nested namespace when file namespace does not match root namespace #82038
  • "Use coalesce expression" drops trivia #82037
    Backlog

Closed

  • IDE0011 should support simplified using statements #82036

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix setting checksum algorithm when mapping projects #82051
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Delete Solution.WithCachedSourceGeneratorState #82050
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: handle remaining member kinds #82043
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Don't offer "Use coalesce expression" when if-statement contains directives #82041
    VSCode
  • Update Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing library #82040
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Adds an analyzer/fixer to inform the user when the compiler silently inserts a fallible explicit cast. #82039
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Set SignType value to 'test' in validation pipeline config #82045
  • Remove remaining PROTOTYPE pieces of `with(...)`, so it can be merged into main. #82030
  • Simplify nullable analysis of collection expression args. #82028
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 2880397 #82035
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Extension indexers: bind CREF #82012
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Fix detection of embedded c# code #82033
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Use document structure in breadcrumbs, sticky scroll, and outline in VSCode #81993
    VSCode
  • Initial support for non-boxing union access pattern HasValue property #82011
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Unions
  • Change logic for how we cache GeneratorDrivers to avoid initialization #81323
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Features/collection expression arguments #81924
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Extension indexers: nullability analysis #81971
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Update BCL packages to 10.0.1 #82020
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Update BCL packages to .NET 10 #81966
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Avoid storing information about unrelated assemblies in AssembliesToWhichInternalAccessHasBeenDetermined #81959
    Area-Compilers
